purpose: Define the evidence required before using an EtherCAT CiA 402 servo drive as the first real bench target.
required_interfaces: dedicated Ethernet interface suitable for EtherCAT master use
drive supporting CiA 402 profile-position or cyclic synchronous modes
safe torque inhibit or equivalent drive inhibit path handled outside this software
required_process_image_objects: 0x60FF target velocity or mode-specific velocity object
pre_purchase_questions: Does the drive expose a documented CiA 402 PDO map for the required objects?
Can the selected host run the intended EtherCAT master with appropriate interface permissions?
Can motion be limited to a low-energy bench configuration for first commissioning?
Can the drive export parameter backups and fault history for evidence?
commissioning_risks: Wrong PDO mapping can make statusword or position feedback misleading.
EtherCAT interface selection and permissions can fail before the controller code is reached.
Physical cable-pull tests must be low energy and must not be used as certified safety evidence.
evidence_required: fault log from heartbeat or bus dropout test
operator_notes: Treat this as a target-selection record, not a vendor recommendation.
Do not change project wording to hardware validation until the evidence_required list is complete.
